description: Render a URL in a real browser and return the image, so you can see the page. Removes cookie banners and ad overlays by default. Costs 1 credit per call. Use full_page for the whole scrollable page, or device to emulate a phone or tablet.

delay.description: Extra wait in ms after load, for late content

format.description: jpeg is markedly smaller and usually enough to read a layout

full_page.description: Capture the whole scrollable page, not just the viewport

return_image.description: false returns only the CDN URL, which keeps a large capture out of the context window

name: capture_screenshot
title: Capture a screenshot
